senses.gloss: f. (v. יוֹשֶׁר a. יָשָׁר) firmness, faith, right conduct, equity.
units: Y. Meg. I, 72ᶜ top (ref. to Deut. XII, 8, cmp. יָשָׁר) ומה תעשו שם דבר שהוא בא לידי י׳ וכ׳ and what dare you do there (on the bamah)? An act by which one is led towards faith, which is burnt-offerings and peace-offerings.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 99:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIX, 4</cite> (ref. to <he>מישרים</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 99:1">ib.</cite>) <he>אתה כוננת י׳ של עולם</he> (ed. Bub. <he>י׳ בעולמך</he>) thou hast established the firmness of thy world (through courts of justice); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 852:17">Yalk. Ps. 852</cite> <he>י׳ בעולמך</he>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54:4">Gen. R. s. 54</cite> (ref. to <he>וישרנה</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 6:12">I Sam. VI, 12</cite>) <he>מהלכות בי׳</he> they walked with propriety (paying reverence to the Ark; Midr. Sam. ch. XII <he>ביופי</he>). Ruth R. introd. 3 (ref. to <he>ישר</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 21:8">Prov. XXI, 8</cite>) <he>במדת י׳</he> in fairness; <cite ref="Proverbs 21:8">ib.</cite> <he>בי׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 959:37">Yalk. Prov. 959</cite>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 8:6">Deut. R. s. 8</cite> <he>היא וכל כלי אומנתה ניתנה … יַשְׁרוּתָה</he> she (the Torah) and all her implements have been given to man, her humility, her righteousness and her fairness.—
